country.evidence_quote: Dietz and Watson is a premium meat and cheese company located in Philadelphia, PA. We’ve been family owned and operated since 1939. Our founder, Gottlieb Dietz, had a saying: “Quality above all else.” For four generations, we’ve continued to use Gottlieb's original recipes and cooking methods to ensure our deli meats, cheeses, sausages and snacks are of the highest quality and freshness.
